plugins.name: zcode-websearch
plugins.description: Web search for ZCode through the Tavily API: a two-step tool pair where web_search returns source links with short snippets and web_fetch reads exactly one URL in full, plus guidance on when to search and how to cite results.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 通过 Tavily API 为 ZCode 提供联网搜索能力：web_search 只返回来源链接与短摘要，web_fetch 每次读一个 URL 的正文；所有长度上限由部署配置而非模型参数决定，以控制上下文开销。

plugins.name: newapi-admin
plugins.description: Full-surface administrator tooling for a New API (new-api) instance: channels, model metadata, model pricing and ratios, users, tokens, redemption codes, logs, statistics, groups, vendors and root system options. Ships a zero-dependency CLI plus an MCP server that reaches every management route, with an authoritative field-level reference distilled from the New API router and source.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 对 New API（new-api）实例做完整管理员运维：渠道、模型元数据、模型定价与倍率、用户、令牌、兑换码、日志、统计、分组、供应商与 Root 系统选项。附带零依赖 CLI 与 MCP 服务，覆盖全部管理路由，并沉淀了一份从 New API 路由与源码提炼的字段级参考文档。

plugins.name: zcode-guide
plugins.description: ZCode usage and self-diagnosis guide: how to configure MCP servers, slash commands, skills, hooks, and plugins, and how to locate and fix configuration problems for each. Migrated from the official ZCode bundle (zcode-plugins-official, MIT by Z.ai).

description_i18n.zh-CN: ZCode 使用与自诊断指南：如何配置 MCP 服务器、斜杠命令、技能、Hooks 与插件，以及逐一排查各类配置问题。迁移自官方 ZCode 内置插件 zcode-guide 0.3.0（MIT，原作者 Z.ai）。

plugins.name: skill-creator
plugins.description: Create, edit, and iterate local ZCode skills. Migrated from the official ZCode bundle (zcode-plugins-official, MIT by Z.ai).

description_i18n.zh-CN: 创建、编辑与迭代本地 ZCode 技能（SKILL.md）。迁移自官方 ZCode 内置插件 skill-creator 0.1.0（MIT，原作者 Z.ai）。

plugins.name: plugin-creator
plugins.description: Develop and validate ZCode plugins through a local dev marketplace, installation, trials and updates. Migrated from the official ZCode bundle (zcode-plugins-official, MIT by Z.ai).

description_i18n.zh-CN: 通过本地开发市场开发并验证 ZCode 插件：脚手架、清单规范、安装试用与更新全流程。迁移自官方 ZCode 内置插件 plugin-creator 0.1.1（MIT，原作者 Z.ai）。
